name: What is the difference between storm damage repair and storm damage restoration?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between storm damage repair and storm damage restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Storm damage repair typically focuses on fixing the immediate visible issues caused by a storm, such as replacing broken windows or patching a roof. Storm damage restoration, however, is a more comprehensive process. It involves not just repairs but also mitigation, cleaning, drying, and rebuilding to return the property to its pre-loss condition, or even better. Restoration addresses hidden issues like water infiltration, mold prevention, and structural integrity, ensuring a complete recovery and long-term safety of the home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair fixes visible damage; restoration is a comprehensive process that mitigates, cleans, dries, and rebuilds to pre-loss condition, addressing hidden issues.
